description: Reads 5 to 60 customer reviews of one business (from Google, Naver, Yelp or anywhere, any language) and returns the top 3 things customers love, the top 3 things they complain about, up to 3 fixes each tied to a complaint, and one strength to use in marketing. Gemini reads the reviews only, without web search; reviewer names and profile lines are removed first. Then OOO Works' checks keep only quotes found word for word in the reviews, count each theme as the number of reviews with such a quote, and drop anything with a reviewer's name, contact details or a number not in the reviews, and any fix that ties a reward to reviews. Themes and fixes are in English or Korean (lang); quotes stay as written. Reviews aren't stored. Limited to 5 runs a day per caller; identical requests are answered from memory for 24 hours.

business_type.description: what the business does, e.g. cafe or dentist; helps the fixes fit

lang.description: language of the themes, fixes and notes: en (default) or ko; quotes stay in the reviews' language

reviews.description: the customer reviews, one per item, 5 to 60, any language, at most 2,000 characters each and 30,000 in all

name: get_review_insights
title: What do customers love and complain about?
